status: reviewed source plan; not an implemented wire format or full renderer
gameplay_authority: original C/Lua; one original effectful preparation per application epoch

boundary.native_geometry: Record each original native client-pointer setter and copy exact enabled typed client arrays immediately before the existing native draw call.
boundary.effective_context: Record the actual GLctx resource/program/pass/state transitions and post-bridge draw observations, including SDL/JS operations that bypass native texture entrypoints.
boundary.join: Stable context/VM generations and one native draw token relate native arrays to consumed WebGL commands. Do not infer equivalence from either stream alone.
boundary.install: Fresh context, after SDL_GL_MakeCurrent and before original resource creation; retain a persistent version ledger through boot, commands and preparation.
boundary.late_attach: Fail closed without a verified bootstrap resource snapshot/history. A raw GL name is never an immutable lease.

texture: owned submitted bytes and exact unpack layout
ordered upload or render-target producer revision
delete tombstone and retained immutable dependencies
program: submitted original and accepted WebGL shader sources
attribute locations and typed input mappings
fixed-function emulation program and pinned bridge provenance
buffer_or_vertex_input: owned effective buffers/index data and attribute normalization/divisor if actually used
source topology and verified converted topology
render_target: predecessor load contents or observed clear
default framebuffer size/viewport and context profile

ordered_commands: clear with mask and effective values
native draw with owned typed arrays and effective resource references
raster_state: modelview/projection or equivalent accepted shader uniforms
native fixed-function texturing/color state required by the pinned bridge

cache_contract.actual_map_path: engine.Map:display calls native toScreen at 611 before unchanged-return at 618; map_to_screen has no FBO-cache early return.
cache_contract.hit: Bind the exact already-owned texture/target revision observed by the original consumer. Capture newly emitted consumer geometry/uniforms/state; retain the historical pure command/owned-byte dependencies.
cache_contract.mutations: Create a new immutable content revision for uploads and target writes. Preserve ordered reads of old/new seen/FBO versions instead of substituting final bytes.
cache_contract.first_hit_without_history: Incomplete frame with a concrete missing_resource_revision; never rerun the producer callback to seed the ledger.
cache_contract.repeat_replay: Use renderer-private resources restored to the packet predecessor state or replay immutable producer command dependencies; never continue from an unrecorded later mutable GPU state.
cache_contract.retirement: Native deletion or handle reuse does not invalidate already-owned packets; release immutable resource revisions only after all dependent packets/platform fences retire.

prohibited_observer_effects: calling original Lua callbacks/getters for missing resources
sampling a new time for uniforms
retrying an original frame after partial failure
using bare native handles as leases
declaring a zero-batch frame cached without recorded resource ownership
readiness_required: native geometry copied at every relevant draw
owned referenced resource revisions and predecessor contents
all callback/particle/UI output in actual source order
verified native-to-WebGL bridge fidelity for used classes
VM/context generation and command/turn exclusion proven
replay touches only renderer-private platform state
current_concrete_gaps: TMP1 captures map scratch float2 geometry only, with raw texture/program/FBO names and mandatory missing-state flags.
Actual particle UVs are GL_SHORT and entity texture geometry has float3 positions.
Native 3D noise upload exists; current upload adapter is 2D-only and baseline disables shaders/multitexture/FBO.
Native UI and cached texture generation occur outside map batches.
Reported pinned SDK planar-array continuation hazard is source-grounded but its proposed repair remains causally unverified.

purity_evidence_contract.comparison: preloaded, synchronous Rust-only replay bracket using host native-byte copies
purity_evidence_contract.outside_bracket: Original SDL/event/timer work remains legitimate dispatcher activity; async whole-heap differences do not identify renderer writes.
purity_evidence_contract.shared_worker_variant: Requires an independent real ownership barrier proof.
